title: Commit Thou All Thy Griefs
description: Commit Thou All Thy Griefs in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 254, “Reliance”, where the book credits them to Moravian.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Com-mit thou all thy griefs And ways in-to His hands, To His sure trust and ten-der care, Who earth and heaven com-mands;

lines: To His sure trust and tender care,
Who points the clouds their course,
He shall direct thy wandering feet,
To Him commend thy cause, — His ear
So safe shall thou go on;
Fix on His work thy steadfast eye,
So shall thy work be done.

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1848.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
